mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0022.retrievePayrollItemList */ a.payroll_item_name , a.inquiry_name , a.payroll_item_id , to_char(to_date(A.start_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd'),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS start_date , to_char(to_date(A.end_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd'),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS end_date FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_m a WHERE a.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND a.payroll_item_name LIKE #{payrollItemName}||'%' AND a.inquiry_name LIKE #{inquiryName}||'%' ORDER BY a.payroll_item_id
